lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Haha, don't be so shocked. Here, come closer.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: It may look like a huge pile of trash, but the real treasures are inside. ♥
Real treasures?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Right this way! ♥
Sora takes my hand and leads me deeper into the junk pile.
Suddenly...
Huh? Is that...?
Buried deep in the mountain of trash, I see a small one-story building.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Let's head in.
I follow Sora into the small building surrounded by a mountain of trash.
The walls are plastered from top to bottom
with photos of planes and of the sky.
One particular photo portrays a massive aircraft.
Scattered amongst the photos are dozens of notes left by someone.
What aircraft is this?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: That's the Wings of Victory. ★
When you say the Wings of Victory, do you mean...

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Yes. The aircraft that was used a long time ago during the 1st Rapture Invasion.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: The same vessel that our squad is attempting to find.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: It's a very precious thing,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: one that must take to the skies again, for the sake of humanity.
I see...

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I'm sure Cielo covered this during your training. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: But because of Storm Bringer, our squad has been grounded for a long time.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Since no one can even attempt to look for the Wings of Victory anymore,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: all we can do is keep supporting the resource-gathering squad.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Of course, if you ask if that kind of work is meaningless...

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Well, I wouldn't say it is meaningless. ☆

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: But, for the sake of our true goal, we can't just focus on one thing. ★
We?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Yes. We...

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: The Collectors.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: You see these messages?
Sora points to the numerous notes posted beside the photo of the Wings of Victory.
"E. 211.05 Desert. Traces found."
"Checked coordinates. No traces of the aircraft found. Only ran into Raptures."
"W 6.053 City. Traces found."
"Learn to tell the difference between a car and an aircraft, you morons."
"S 77.221 Forest. Traces? Something that looks like a broken-off piece of a wing."
"Seems like it could be from a different aircraft. Not sure."
"There are too many Raptures nearby. Let's head there together next time."
Hang on, are you saying the aircraft they're looking for is...

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: That's right. ♡

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: These are all records of our past searches for the Wings of Victory.
I didn't expect the Collectors to be searching for such a thing.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text:
We are,
and we have been for quite some time. ☆

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Hmm... ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Maybe a year or two after I joined the squad?
Isn't that the same time you said you started smuggling?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: That's right. ♡
So, could it be that you were smuggling...?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Can you turn around?
At Sora's request, I turn around.
In one corner of the room, a stack of crates catches my eye.
One of the boxes is open, revealing medical supplies and blood-stained bandages inside.
Are those...

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: They're the supplies I smuggled in from the surface. ☆

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I just grabbed anything that looked useful,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: and look, I've got quite a collection. ★
Is it all medical equipment?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Medical equipment, food supplies,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: and exploration tools, ☆

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: and well, all sorts of other things too! ★
If it's just stuff like this, it'd be better to get it properly as official support supplies rather than smuggling...

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: From who?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: The Central Government?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Haha, you know that's not possible.
But surely, Ingrid could help you?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: You're right. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: The Boss definitely would've helped us behind the scenes. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: But our squad's already gotten plenty of help from her when it comes to searching for the Wings of Victory.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: She was the one who pushed the Central Government to let us do short aerial searches, just an hour each.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: She really went all out for us.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: But somehow, the Central Government flat-out rejected even that.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: They refused so strongly, not even the Boss could make them budge.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: And after that, they started piling us with support missions,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: just to keep us from even thinking about aerial searches again. ★
... They really went that far?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Yeah. ★ It's strange, isn't it?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: But come on, how could I possibly ask the Boss for even more help in a situation like this? ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: And if something were to happen to her just because she tried to help us... I'd never be able to forgive myself.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: As for anyone else who could help us...

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Collectors are viewed as dangerous, even by those in the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Well, let's just say we're not exactly seen in the best light.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: No one in the Ark would ever dream of helping folks as dangerous as us.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: We tried using our own money at first and everything we could think of... ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: But it just wasn't nearly enough. ♥

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I know it sounds like I'm just making excuses, but... that's why I had to resort to this.
Sorry for thinking of it so simply...

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Hehe, it's okay.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text:
I know full well this isn't exactly a justified
act. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: But if we didn't do this,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: there's no way we Collectors would last as long as they do up on the surface.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: After all, we're talking about a place where it's difficult even for Nikkes to survive.
Why are the Collectors taking such a risk to search for the Wings of Victory?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: 'Cause we want to live in the light. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Don't people say that where there's a will, there's a way?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Well, we're no different. ♥

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: We want to live under the real sky,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: where the light shines equally upon everyone.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: To make that happen, we have to reclaim the surface. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: And for that, we absolutely need the Wings of Victory.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Without a doubt, we're the ones in the Ark who want it the most.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: That's why we decided to search for it ourselves.
I... see.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Welp, that's all there is to my secret. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: That's all I've got to say.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Now, do you want to make a deal with me?
Um...
I recall everything from the moment I met Sora during flight training up until now.
The memories of flying paper airplanes with her,
the way she saved me when I was in trouble during the turbulence training,
receiving that message she accidentally sent me,
and every moment I spent tracking her afterward.
I remember the moment she suggested we make a deal,
and the secrets I learned about her after coming here.
Suddenly, a thought strikes me.
... Is all of this really just a coincidence?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Are you having trouble deciding?
Can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Of course. ☆
That message you sent to me by mistake.
Did you actually mean to send that to me?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: What makes you say that?
I figured out everything very easily. Too easily.
You've never been caught smuggling before,
so I think everything was handled way too carelessly this time.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Wow, you really think so highly of me!

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Hehe, but you got that right. I sent it on purpose. ★
Why... would you do that?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: That's because... ♥

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I just really wanted to show you this, Captain.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I wanted it to be a memory you'd never forget.
Why me?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Well... ♥

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: If the Wings of Victory ever takes flight again, I figured you'd be the one piloting it.
Now you're pulling my leg.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I'm not! ♥

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I really mean it!

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I truly believe you'll be the one flying that legendary aircraft.
Why would you go that far... for me?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Hmm, well...

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Just looking at what you've pulled off with the Counters, I could list a ton of reasons. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: But if I'm being honest... maybe it's just a hunch?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Maybe it's because I used to be a Collector too. ☆

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I can tell, y'know? Who's shining the brightest in the Ark right now,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: and who will actually treat us like human beings. ☆

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: That's why I want you on our side. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Even if I had to make it look like a mistake, I was going to send that message, no matter what.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I wanted to grab onto the most promising lifeline we had

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: and show them what we're really after.
Is that why you call me Captain?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Yes and no. ♥

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Yeah, I really do believe you're the one who'll lead us,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: but there's more to it than that. ★

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: The first time we met, it honestly was just by chance.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: You came into my life at the most unexpected moment.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: As silly as it sounds, I guess you could say it was love at first sight for me. ♥

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: That's why I started calling you Captain, and why I say it with so much affection.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: On that day, right then and there, I just knew it had to be you.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Sounds crazy, right?
I look at Sora's face.
The same face that gave me medicine
on that day I struggled to breathe.
... Yeah, I believe you.
I believe that what you've told me so far is true.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: ... Thank you.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Anyway, that's why I wanted to show you this place, Captain. ☆

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Because I trust you. Because I care for you.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: And now that

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: you know everything,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I'm not asking for some half-assed deal where you just turn a blind eye to the illegal things I've done.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I want you to make a real deal with me.
What do you mean, "a real deal"?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Feel free to report me to the Central Government

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: or the A.C.P.U. for smuggling. ☆

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I'll leave that entirely up to you, Captain.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: But no matter what, even if it costs us our lives,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: we will find the Wings of Victory.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: So when the day comes that the Wings of Victory soars again,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: all I ask is that you don't forget the efforts that we made.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Remember the blood, sweat, and tears of those who wandered the surface to make this happen,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: and take us with you.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Take us to that brilliant world beyond the horizon,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: where the light shines down equally on everyone!
I see Sora looking at me with a face full of trust.
I see countless messages from Collectors plastered on the walls, all desperate to find the Wings of Victory.
My eyes fall on the crates of medical supplies Sora smuggled past inspections.
And between those boxes, a bloodstained bandage lies draped.
I can see their longing clearly, right before my eyes.
Fine. Let's make a deal.
I'll turn a blind eye to the smuggling until we find the Wings of Victory.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I swear that

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: once we find the Wings of Victory,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I'll never do anything like this ever again.
Also...
When the Wings of Victory take flight once again,
I won't forget you, and I'll be with you,
no matter what.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Hehe, all right! ☆

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: I'll be waiting eagerly for the day we find the Wings of Victory for you, Captain,

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: and fly across the horizon together. ☆
